skill.name: http-api-cloudbase
skill.description: Guides agents to build raw HTTP integrations for CloudBase platform APIs, including authentication, gateway URLs, OpenAPI lookup, and REST examples.
skill.summary: Build CloudBase HTTP API clients with verified endpoints, authentication, and safe request patterns.
skill.author: tencentcloudbase

content.value_statement: CloudBase teams need reliable raw HTTP integrations when SDKs are unavailable. This skill guides endpoint selection, authentication, OpenAPI lookup, and safe request construction.
actual_capabilities: Routes CloudBase tasks to raw HTTP APIs instead of SDK or MCP workflows.
Lists CloudBase API families and matching OpenAPI lookup names.
Explains AccessToken, API Key, and Publishable Key authentication choices.
Shows gateway URL patterns for domestic and international CloudBase regions.
Provides request patterns for functions, relational databases, NoSQL, and AI model APIs.
Highlights URL encoding, WHERE clauses, and secure token handling practices.
limitations: Does not provide an executable client library or automatic request runner.
Requires OpenAPI results before exact endpoints and schemas are finalized.
Does not replace CloudBase SDK guidance for supported SDK platforms.
Uses placeholders for environment IDs, regions, tokens, and resource names.

use_cases.title: Build Mobile Backend Calls
use_cases.description: Use raw HTTP for iOS, Android, Flutter, or React Native clients when a CloudBase SDK is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Create Admin Scripts
use_cases.description: Prepare server-side HTTP clients for database, function, storage, or AI model API calls.

use_cases.title: Review API Routing
use_cases.description: Check whether a task belongs to raw HTTP APIs, SDK flows, MCP management, or CloudBase-hosted services.

prompt_templates.title: Choose HTTP API Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether my CloudBase task should use raw HTTP APIs or an SDK. Ask for missing environment, region, and auth details.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a safe curl request for a CloudBase function call using placeholders for env ID, region, and token.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Database Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a CloudBase relational database REST flow with auth headers, query filters, response handling, and update safeguards.

prompt_templates.title: Implement OpenAPI-Based Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CloudBase OpenAPI spec for ai_model to design a non-SDK HTTP client with validation, retries, and secure token handling.

output_examples.input: I need to call a CloudBase function from Flutter without an SDK.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects raw HTTP routing, asks for environment and auth details, then outlines the gateway URL, headers, body, and error handling.

output_examples.input: I need a server script that updates a CloudBase relational table.
output_examples.output: The assistant requests the OpenAPI spec, confirms the table path, adds an update filter requirement, and describes safe token storage.

output_examples.input: I am unsure whether this task belongs to HTTP API or MCP management.
output_examples.output: The assistant compares the task against the routing checklist and directs API calls, SDK work, and management actions to the correct workflow.

best_practices: Verify the official OpenAPI spec before choosing endpoints or parameters.
Use API Keys only on trusted servers and keep all bearer tokens protected.
URL encode query values and include filters for update and delete operations.
anti_patterns: Placing server API keys in client-side mobile or browser code.
Inventing endpoint paths from memory instead of checking OpenAPI.
Using this skill for SDK-supported Web, Node, or mini program flows.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps agents build raw HTTP integrations for official CloudBase platform APIs.

faq.question: Does it run HTTP requests?
faq.answer: No. It is documentation for generating or reviewing request code and command examples.

faq.question: Which authentication methods are covered?
faq.answer: It covers AccessToken, API Key, and Publishable Key usage guidance.

faq.question: Can I use server API keys in clients?
faq.answer: No. Server API keys must stay in trusted server-side environments.

faq.question: How should endpoints be verified?
faq.answer: Use the CloudBase OpenAPI lookup before writing exact paths, parameters, or schemas.

faq.question: Does it replace CloudBase SDKs?
faq.answer: No. Use SDK-specific guidance when the target platform has a supported CloudBase SDK.
